translated: And now, I'd like to watch the 2DMV for "Kitty" that was released yesterday
together with all of you.
This song was written for us by Tsumiki-san, and wasn't it just incredible?
The full version, I mean.
The tempo from the second verse onward is a classic Tsumiki-san move.
It's slightly different from the first verse, and that's what makes it so great.
I want to talk more about the music, but first,
I'd like for us to watch the MV together.
Please take a look.
This part is so good.
Show us what comes next!
The second verse is the best.
Kanade singing "AM 1 o'clock" is just wonderful.
How did Tomori-chan sing it like that this time?
I absolutely need them to release an Another Vocal version.
I really want to hear it.
How many different voices does Tomori-chan have in her throat?
She's truly amazing.
I'll have to ask Tomori-chan.
Maybe I'll go to Tomori-chan's house.
Yeah, I'll ask Tomori-chan about it.
It was really great.
It's written as "1 AM" but sung as "AM 1 o'clock."
It's so cool.
Some people were trying their best to read it as "25 o'clock"
and saying how cool it was, but I was watching the comments thinking, "Actually, it's AM..."
I'd love for you to watch the full version on the official channel,
but I wonder if I was the only one Tsumiki-san recorded personally?
I'm not sure if he recorded the other girls too.
Tsumiki-san directed me and gave me very specific nuances.
For example, for the line "ajike no nai," I had my own way of saying it,
but the sound Tsumiki-san had in his head was different
from the sound I was hearing. For "ajike no nai yoru ni toketa,"
he wanted me to sing the "ta" part with a descending feel, so I really struggled
with that specific spot.
I kept wanting to drop the pitch on "ajike no nai."
It was surprisingly difficult.
And for the "ha-ah-ah" part, I wanted to do it normally,
but the direction was to make it really strong.
I wasn't even trying to growl, but after doing take after take,
I lost track of what I was doing, and one just happened to come out all raspy.
He said, "That's great!" and that's the one they used. I was surprised when I saw the MV
and realized they picked that one.
It was tough.
Just catching the notes for "Kitty" was incredibly hard,
so I had to slow it down... by how much?
Like 4 times slower to catch the melody for "jigetsu sae mo kodoku na tenge de."
Since I can't read sheet music, that's how I had to do it.
Also, for the "one, two, three, four" part,
there's a score for it, but the direction was to not sing it on pitch.
If everyone gets an Another Vocal version,
I won't be able to hear the second verse unless I specifically ask to.
I'm really curious how everyone else said "one, two, three, four."
It was more like a spoken line, and I was told not to worry about the notes at all.
I'm so curious how the others did it that I want to hear all four versions.
So that was "Kitty," and it really was the best.
It's so cool that I seriously want to sing it at karaoke.
I really want to sing it at karaoke.
People are asking if everyone gets an Another Vocal, but I just said "if" they do.
Please don't misunderstand.
I don't know whose Another Vocal will be released.
There's no one here for me to confirm with, so I really don't know.
I hope you'll look forward to them being added later.
I want to hear Kanade's version, but I also really want to hear a Tomori Kusunoki version.
I seriously want to hear a "Tomori-chan Sings" version of this.
It would suit Tomori-chan so well.
I'm certain of it.
I hope everyone enjoys listening to it.
We only showed a portion today, but the full version is up on the official ProSeka YouTube channel,
so please be sure to check it out.
